project_overview.name: SQLAM Dunk - NBA SQL Investigation Platform
project_overview.design_archetype: Vintage Sports Editorial x Retro Arcade Dossier (Swiss / Noir Court Analytic)
project_overview.core_concept: Re-imagining a database learning platform into a 1990s NBA press-room / court-side investigation terminal. Replacing generic modern AI SaaS dark grids with tactile editorial typography, warm parchment & deep court mahogany tones, physical stamp/badge visual hierarchy, micro-textures, and high-impact pixel-art asset showcases.
key_functionalities_preserved: Landing page with featured investigation & NBA historical roadmap
Supabase email/password authentication modal & session persistence
Interactive 7-game SQL challenge workspace with chapter selection
DuckDB-WASM client-side query execution against real NBA box score CSVs
Challenge progression, unlocking rules, and game scoping
XP, coin rewards, and career rank leveling
Solved-state persistence (local storage + Supabase profile metadata sync)
Query journal recording execution history per challenge

typography.headline_font: Barlow Condensed / Cabinet Grotesk / Syne (Display High-Impact Heavy Condensed)
typography.body_font: DM Sans / Inter (Clean Geometric for high-density tabular legibility)
typography.code_font: JetBrains Mono / Fira Code (Tactile Terminal Monospace)

hierarchy_rules.hero_heading: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-[0.92]
hierarchy_rules.eyebrow_label: text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#f0a830]

anti_ai_type_principles: Avoid default unstyled Inter for headings; use heavy condensed uppercase display typography with tight leading.
Incorporate wide mono tracking (tracking-[0.25em]) for file stamps, game timestamps, and badge tags.
Use stark contrast in text weights: 900 Black for titles vs 400 Light for descriptive subtitles.

color_system.theme_mode: Court Noir & Editorial Warmth (Dark Baseline with Ochre & Mahogany Accents)

image_and_gif_inventory.manager_gif: /gifs/manager.gif (Senior Analytics Manager Jordan Ellis Briefing Avatar)

styling_rules: Frame player GIFs in tactile court-card containers with subtle scanline overlays or solid 2px offset borders.
Display Manager Jordan Ellis avatar inside the briefing box as an animated court-side wiretap monitor.
Toggle Maya Carter's avatar dynamically: /gifs/maya.gif during editor entry/queries and /gifs/maya_happy.gif upon correct evidence solution.
Show chapter GIFs as historical game tapes in the sidebar and evidence modal headers.

landing_page.hero_section: Asymmetric editorial spread with large display banner ('EVERY QUERY IS A SHOT'), floating evidence tag, dual pixel-art finals illustration cards with golden offset borders, and quick action pill buttons.
landing_page.case_001_card: Styled like a physical classified Case Dossier folder (#132032 background, #f0a830 accent tab, key figure GIF avatars in trading-card grid layout).
landing_page.learning_path: Bento grid with 7 game cards styled as chronological box score archives featuring concept tags and game dates.
landing_page.roadmap: Two-column stadium ticket view comparing Case 001 (Active Investigation) with Case 002 (Locked Vault).

investigation_workspace.header_bar: Sticky court console header with quick exit button, live COINS indicator, XP indicator, solved ratio badge, and current game chapter timestamp.
investigation_workspace.left_sidebar: Career Profile ID Badge (Maya Carter avatar frame, current analyst rank, XP progress bar) + Chronological Game Navigator with lock icons and completion checkmarks.
investigation_workspace.center_editor_panel: Dual briefing & objective box featuring Jordan Ellis GIF avatar, DuckDB SQL console with custom syntax highlight line-numbers and execution controls, and responsive DuckDB result set data table with sticky headers.
investigation_workspace.right_inspector_panel: Evidence Board table schema viewer, 3-tier coin hint system, and live query journal ticker.

motion_and_micro_interactions.hover_effects: Card lift (-translate-y-1) + shadow expand on interactive cards.
motion_and_micro_interactions.buttons: Tactile press effect (translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] with active shadow collapse).
motion_and_micro_interactions.sql_execution: Pulsing amber state during DuckDB execution; crisp slide-in alert for errors and success feedback.
motion_and_micro_interactions.level_up_toast: Modal takeover overlay for completed game chapters with animated evidence unlock text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all existing logic in /lib/case-001-data.ts, /lib/campaign-data.ts, /lib/campaign-sql.ts, /lib/duckdb-engine.ts, and /lib/supabase-browser.ts remains 100% intact.
Do not break or modify data structures, props, or query verification algorithms.
Enhance components with rich CSS styling, custom retro shadow effects, warm paper & court color palettes, and clear data-testid attributes.
Keep mobile responsiveness seamless with collapsible sidebars and touch-scrolling data tables.
